description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperienceDecorator class, which provides additional behavior and formatting functions for the EmpWorkExperience entity within the OrangeHRM software system. It includes methods to access work experience dates, duration, and associate an employee by employee number.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperienceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds presentation-layer formatting and auxiliary methods to the EmpWorkExperience entity, facilitating data access and manipulation specific to the HRM application's requirements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpWorkExperience entity instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the work experience based on the employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'from' date of the work experience.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'to' date of the work experience.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration of the work experience in years, rounded to one decimal place.
